description: Independent synthetic evidence and page specifications. All statements concern this invented corpus, never production systems.

sources.body: TEST_ONLY: repeated requests with the same Idempotency-Key produce one widget in this fictional protocol.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional retry policy uses exponential backoff.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional retry policy uses full jitter.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional read route is /v1/widgets/{widget_id}.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional cache settings are described by cache_policy.py.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional transaction acquires a row lock using SELECT ... FOR UPDATE.
TEST_ONLY: a second synthetic observation records the same row locking protocol.
TEST_ONLY: observation A sets the maximum window to 10 ticks.
TEST_ONLY: observation B sets the maximum window to 30 ticks.
TEST_ONLY: demo-orion uses request timeout 4100ms and timeout_ms=4100.
TEST_ONLY: demo-lyra uses request timeout 8800ms and timeout_ms=8800.
TEST_ONLY: demo-lyra cache TTL is recorded in cache_ttl_ms.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional former transport choice was a polling channel.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional current transport choice is an event channel.
TEST_ONLY: a storage proposal suggests an append-only journal; it is not approved.
TEST_ONLY: the fictional copy-on-write operation retains the previous buffer.
TEST_ONLY: optimistic concurrency in this invented protocol compares ETag with If-Match.
